name: Damask
author: Erin Carter
description: A heavy damask curtain fills the frame: brick-tiled foliate scrollwork woven into cloth that hangs in soft vertical pleats, each crest catching a fixed satin sheen while its valleys drown to black. The light is bolted down and the cloth does the moving — a draft sways the pleats side-to-side, deepening toward the hem on a sum of incommensurate slow sines, so no band ever travels across the wall.

params.label: Sway speed
params.effect: Multiplies the draft driving the curtain; 0 hangs the cloth perfectly still (pleats lit but frozen), 2 sets the whole wall gently billowing.

params.label: Pleat width
params.effect: Width of each vertical pleat in CSS pixels — many narrow candlestick folds at the minimum, a few broad theatrical waves at the maximum.

params.label: Scroll size
params.effect: Size of each scrollwork brick in CSS pixels — a fine wallpaper of many small motifs at the minimum, a few grand scrolls at the maximum.

params.label: Fold depth
params.effect: Depth of the pleating — scales both the sway relief and the crest-to-valley contrast, from a nearly flat softly shaded hanging to deep folds whose valleys drown in black.
